findings.passage: With all the things going on at the Southern border, illegal immigration is a concern amongst many of our constituents throughout the state and that has brought that issue to the forefront,
findings.note: Gives his reason for the 2024 constitutional amendment on who may vote; quoted by WKU Public Radio.

findings.passage: This is really a common sense fix to an issue that might never become an issue, but it's a lot easier to handle these things in a proactive manner than to react to them if they do,
findings.note: Describes the amendment as a preventive fix and says he knows of no cases of noncitizens voting in Kentucky; quoted by WKU Public Radio.

findings.passage: Not in state elections, not in federal elections, but they’re doing it at the local level. Voting in local elections. They’re voting in school board elections.
findings.note: Quoted by LEX18 from a September 2024 press conference of the amendment's supporters; says other places let noncitizens vote in local elections.

findings.passage: If you want to become a citizen, there’s a pathway to that.
findings.note: Quoted by LEX18 (September 2024 press conference); says voting should be for citizens.
